name: ViewRaw
description: Copy and view the raw content/data of any message, channel or guild
summary: View and copy the raw content and JSON of messages, channels and servers
notes: "Message Data" is the message as Qord stores it (sorted keys; no private author fields), which can differ slightly from Discord's payload. The entries are in the message context menu.
gaps: Upstream's hover-bar button (and its left/right click setting) needs plugin buttons in the message action bar
View Raw for users, channels, servers, roles and profiles needs those context menus to expose their data
